scope: Proposition 7.1 (Transport from a fixed apex) of the manuscript “Prescribed large-volume charges on threefolds with trivial canonical bundle” (preprints/Prescribed-large-volume-charges-on-threefolds-with-trivial-canonical-bundle-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 055 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ce978a67015704), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a smooth projective complex threefold X, an integral ample class H, and B0 ∈ N1(X)Q. Suppose that there are A > 0 and C ≥ 0 such that every finite-slope tilt-semistable object of slope zero at (A, b), for every b ∈ R, satisfies DA(E) ≤ CSA(E). (7.2) Then, with R0 = A + 3C A , k0 = max { C + A2 6 , CR0 A } , (7.3) every finite-slope tilt-semistable object of slope zero at (a, b) satisfies Da(E) ≤ k0db(E) for all a > 0, b ∈ R, and Da(E) ≤ 0 whenever a > R0.
